card.name: Digits inside patent reference numerals
card.fires_on: A digit inside a three-digit reference numeral that labels a part in a patent figure description, such as 135, 115 or 130. The numeral follows a component name like server, cluster, network or phone.

modes.label: Middle digit of numeral
modes.description: The middle digit of a three-digit numeral after a device name.

modes.label: First or last digits
modes.description: The first or second digit of a numeral after a network or processor name.
modes.example: The packet network <<1>>05 may interface with an IP Multimedia

card.plain: It marks the digits of the part numbers that patent text puts after component names like server or network.
